title: Arabidopsis Growth Medium with Varying Sulfur and Nitrogen Content
author: Meike Burow
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5q6g5ze
materials: Media solution stock solutions +S/+N A+C+G +S/-N A+D+G -S/+N B+E+H -S/-N B+F+H media recipes.xlsx

steps.title: Combine stock solutions to 1 L
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL minor salts (100×), 100 mL major salts (10×), 10 mL ferrous solution (100×), and 1 mL vitamin mix (1000×, Murashige and Skoog) to distilled water and bring the total volume to 1 L.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL vitamin mix (1000×, Murashige and Skoog).
Adjust the solution to a final volume of 1 L with distilled water.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 5.8
steps.instruction: Measure the pH of the 1 L medium and adjust to 5.8 using 1 M KOH.

steps.title: Aliquot into 500 mL bottles
steps.instruction: Divide the 1 L of adjusted medium into two equal 500 mL portions, each placed in a 1 L bottle.

steps.title: Add agar and sterilize
steps.instruction: To each 500 mL portion add 4 g agar (Remel) and autoclave the mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 g agar (Remel) per 500 mL of medium.
Autoclave the agar‑supplemented medium according to standard plant‑media sterilization conditions.

steps.title: Dispense into plates
steps.instruction: After cooling, dispense 50 mL of the sterile medium into each square Petri plate.

steps.title: Set sulfate and nitrate levels
steps.instruction: Prepare media variants with the following final ion concentrations: sulfate 1.68 mM for +S and 0.015 mM for –S; nitrate 3 mM for +N and 0.3 mM for –N.

substeps.instruction: For +S media, ensure sulfate concentration is 1.68 mM.
For –S media, ensure sulfate concentration is 0.015 mM.
For +N media, ensure nitrate concentration is 3 mM.
For –N media, ensure nitrate concentration is 0.3 mM.
